title: Acoustic Disguising: Green's function extraction and hologram synthesis
description: Julia and Python code accompanying the paper 'Acoustic disguising: a unified framework for cloaking and holography'. Generates acoustic Green's functions from an impulsive point source or extracts them from reverberating data via Multi-Dimensional Deconvolution (MDD), and synthesises acoustic holograms from the Green's functions.
